name: 3-in-1 Foldable Magnetic Wireless Charger 15W Charging Station for iPhone Apple Watch and AirPods
description:
Upgrade your charging routine with the 3-in-1 Foldable Magnetic Wireless Charger. This compact station allows you to charge your iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods simultaneously with 15W/5W/2.5W outputs. The foldable 180° design doubles as a phone stand, while magnetic suction ensures secure MagSafe alignment for iPhones. Slim and lightweight, it fits easily in your pocket or bag, making it perfect for home, office, or travel. Equipped with a built-in smart chip and LED indicator lights, it provides safe, efficient, and visible charging at all times.
Key Features:
 Power: 15W fast charge for iPhones, 5W for AirPods, 2.5W for Apple Watch
 Design: Foldable 180° design, doubles as stand for horizontal or vertical viewing
 Magnetic Suction: Secure MagSafe alignment for iPhone 12/13/14 series
 LED Indicator: Shows charging status for each device clearly
 Compatibility: iPhone 14/13/12/11 series, Apple Watch 2–7/SE, AirPods Pro/2 (wireless), Qi-enabled earbuds and phones
 Safety: Smart chip for over-voltage, over-current, and temperature protection
 Material: Soft silicone, compact and portable for easy carrying
How to Use:
 Connect to an 18W+ fast adapter (not included)
 Place iPhone on magnetic pad for automatic alignment
 Position Apple Watch on the charging dock
 Place AirPods on the wireless charging base
 Fold flat for storage or carry on-the-go
Safety Information:
 Always use with 18W or higher adapter for best results
 Avoid placing keys, coins, or metal near charging area
 Do not expose to water, direct heat, or extreme temperatures
 Keep out of reach of children
Package Includes:
 1 × 3-in-1 Foldable Magnetic Wireless Charger
 1 × USB-C Charging Cable
